## What this changes

A short description of the change and the problem it solves.

## Why

The motivation, and any alternative you considered.

## How it was verified

The exact commands you ran and their result — for example:

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s src/scripts/tests -t src/scripts
```

## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change, scoped to the stated intent.
- [ ] Tests pass, or the change is docs-only.
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) updated under `## [Unreleased]` for a
      user-visible change.
- [ ] No security vulnerability disclosed here — see
      [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
